event_definition.first_passage: continuous crossing of x=0 into opposite source half on accepted linear RK segment
event_definition.residence: accepted segment time in the opposite source half
event_definition.return: first later crossing back to the seed's origin half

provenance.endpoint_time_tolerance_basis: Reuse declared 3e-5 s native-output jitter budget from nominal diagnostic; no tolerance change.
provenance.event_definition_policy: must match exact binding event_definition; continuous halfspace x=0 events only
provenance.purpose: Full-window amplitude high spatial diagnostic; no T2 qualification

seed_axis.pairing: same deterministic seed hash and exact initial positions/source labels

comparison_limits.cdf_sup_difference: interval bound is max(|right_lower-left_upper|, |right_upper-left_lower|) over the union step grid
comparison_limits.native_dense_vs_matched010: right trace may use a direct selected native-frame map; no interpolation-created frame is accepted
comparison_limits.t2: not assessed; source/trace scope and material reliability remain candidate diagnostics
comparison_limits.unknown_gate_1_percent: reported only; this comparator does not waive or reinterpret it

denominator_policy.residence: all seeds contribute observed residence; support-loss seeds receive conservative remaining-window upper interval; reliable no-contact seeds contribute exact zero
denominator_policy.source_mass: all geometric seeds, uniform weight 1/N per trace; no source_contact subset
denominator_policy.unknown: permanent_unknown seeds remain in every source denominator
denominator_policy.unobserved_events: event lower bound uses finite observed event times; upper bound adds unresolved unknown mass from its first possible failure time

material_reliability_status: uncalibrated; numerical support_unknown is not material reliability

left.denominator_policy: all independent geometric seeds in this source; uniform per-trace weight=1/512
left.residence_metric: cumulative opposite-source halfspace time within observed window
